raw.details:
Mern Stack Coding Challenge 2026

Organized by TechFusion

About the Competition

Are you ready to test your technical knowledge, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills?

TechFusion presents the MERN Stack Coding Challenge 2026, an online technical competition designed to evaluate participants on aptitude, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, MERN Stack development, and core Computer Science fundamentals.

The challenge will feature a combination of MCQs, theoretical questions, and real-world case-based problems. Participants will have 60 minutes to demonstrate their knowledge, apply their concepts, and compete for a position among the top three performers.

Participate individually, challenge yourself, and showcase your technical skills!

Event Details

  • Date: 1 December 2026
  • Mode: Completely Remote / Online
  • Duration: 60 Minutes
  • Participation: Individual Only
  • Organized By: TechFusion, the Technical and Coding Club of the CSE Department, HIET Ghaziabad

Competition Domains

1. Aptitude and Logical Reasoning

Test your analytical thinking, numerical ability, and logical reasoning skills.

2. Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning

Evaluate your understanding of fundamental AI and ML concepts, terminology, and applications.

3. MERN Stack Development

Test your knowledge of MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js, and full-stack web development concepts.

4. Core Computer Science Subjects

Demonstrate your understanding of fundamental Computer Science concepts and technical subjects.

5. Real-World Case-Based Questions

Apply your technical knowledge and conceptual understanding to practical scenarios and problem-solving situations.

Competition Format

Participants will receive 60 minutes to complete the assessment, which may include:

  • Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs)
  • Theoretical and concept-based questions
  • Real-world case-based problems
  • Aptitude and logical reasoning questions

Effective time management and conceptual clarity will be essential to performing well.

Prizes and Recognition Applicable for those who will pay:

The Top 3 Performers will be rewarded for their performance.

  • 1st Place: ₹500 Cash Prize + Customized Water Bottle
  • 2nd Place: ₹500 Cash Prize + Customized Water Bottle
  • 3rd Place: ₹500 Cash Prize + Customized Water Bottle

Total Cash Prize Pool: ₹1,500

Each winner will receive a cash prize and a customized water bottle as a token of recognition.

Who Can Participate?

This competition is ideal for students and aspiring developers interested in:

  • MERN Stack and full-stack web development
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
  • Computer Science fundamentals
  • Aptitude and logical reasoning
  • Technical assessments and competitive challenges

Note: Participation is strictly individual. Team participation is not permitted.

Rules and Guidelines

  • The competition will be conducted entirely online.
  • Each participant must register and participate individually.
  • The total assessment duration is 60 minutes.
  • Responses must be submitted within the prescribed time.
  • Participants are responsible for maintaining a stable internet connection and using a suitable device.
  • All participants must follow the instructions provided by the organizing team.
  • The organizers' decision regarding evaluation and final rankings will be final.

Ready to Take the Challenge?

Test your technical knowledge, strengthen your problem-solving skills, and compete for the top three positions.

Register now. Challenge yourself. Compete for excellence.
